caption: A rainbow appears in the mist at the foot of a waterfall on a sunny day, and fades when a cloud covers the sun.

sa.check: A rainbow appears in the mist at the foot of a waterfall.
The day is sunny before the cloud.
The cloud comes first and the fade follows.

pc.expect: The rainbow sits within the mist opposite the sun and disappears when the sun is hidden.
pc.fail: It is on the rock; or stays bright with the sun hidden; or appears with no sun.

pc.expect: The rainbow keeps its arc while the sun shines and does not move across the scene.
pc.fail: It moves; or changes shape; or a second rainbow appears.

pc.expect: The bands show the spectrum's order.
pc.fail: They are in random order; or a single colour; or change colours.

pc.expect: The waterfall falls and the mist drifts.
pc.fail: The water rises; or the mist hangs rigidly; or falls upward.
A second waterfall appears; or it vanishes; or the rainbow becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The rocks and the trees stay the same.
pc.fail: The rocks rearrange; or the trees change; or the water changes colour.
